# COLOR001: color-off-palette

| Field | Value |

A colour literal that is not a palette colour (and not a translucent variant of an opaque one).

## Examples

### COLOR001 colour literal outside the palette / A hex literal outside the palette fires #1 (line 10) (fire)

```css
.btn {
  color: #ff0000;
}
```

```tsx
}
```
